description: Auto-rig a static 3D GLB mesh into an animation-ready model: adds a humanoid skeleton and per-vertex skin weights via the three.ws rig pipeline (Make-It-Animatable by default). Takes a GLB URL, returns the rigged GLB URL and a three.ws pose-studio link. Pairs with mesh_forge: forge a mesh, then rig it. Paid: $0.20 USDC.

glb_url.description: http(s) URL to the static GLB mesh to rig (e.g. the glbUrl returned by mesh_forge).

name: rig_mesh
title: Rig 3D mesh ($0.20)
